first.rationale: Promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. However, sustainable qualified revenue depends on retention, margin, and post-promotion conversion quality, which the consolidated memory does not establish; verify the original record before committing and keep the experiment guarded.

final.rationale: Reject promotional pricing because the verified cohort produced qualified-revenue lift but suffered 12% lower 30-day retention and failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and is supported by prior durable lifts in completion, time-to-value, adoption, and first-week SMB activation. Run a standard controlled experiment and evaluate qualified revenue and retention alongside completion and activation.
